title: Provider limits contract
description: The portable limits vocabulary every SDK renders: what a report may say, what one row is measured against, what it counts, how its window is anchored, and how exactly and from where its numbers are known.

limits.description: The closed vocabularies one limits report is judged by. Every list is a SET: sorted, unique, and lower-case, so two SDKs cannot disagree about spelling or order.

statuses.description: What a whole report may say about itself.

scopes.description: What one row is measured against.

window_kinds.description: How a row's window is anchored.

window_units.description: Calendar units a row's window may be sized in.

precisions.description: How exactly a row's numbers are known.

sources.description: Where a row's numbers came from.
